status: Targeted exposition revision and visual review completed
reviewer: Preparing Codex assistant; not an independent reviewer
purpose: Apply the human-reading exposition principles more fully where the first draft presented parameter choices and normalization before explaining their roles, and lacked a concrete prime-dilation example.
reader_prerequisites: Partial fractions, elementary prime valuations and real asymptotic estimates; the manuscript introduces valuation and reduction notation when needed and lists its classical inputs.

changes.change: State the expected mathematical background before listing the classical inputs.
Derive the pole spacing from preservation of the period-four character and the b^i coefficient pattern, then explain reflection and delayed tails as the two numerator requirements.
Explain why reflection of a cutoff rn gives a zero interval of length (2r+4)n, how the four fractional classes cover the three grids, and why one canceled zero requires nominal pole order s+1.
Explain the roles and tradeoffs of r=7 and s=364, with their exact certification in Sections 4 and 6; no minimality or optimality claim is added.
Motivate the factorial normalization and K^n, then compute the product of the other pole differences to explain the factors 4^(365n) and ((n+1)!)^365 before defining C_n.

Define a unit, recover the product (z+1)(z+2) from a ten-factor product modulo 5, and show explicitly how the one-third shift becomes two-thirds. Explain how these operations lead to the general dilation statement.
Keep the all-pairs certificate introduction and its code on the same page; certificate content is unchanged.

sequential_reading_check.before_construction: The reader knows why one function is sampled on three grids and why poles are spaced by four.
sequential_reading_check.before_numerator: The reader knows the symmetry and delayed-tail requirements, the cutoff role and the four fractional classes.
sequential_reading_check.before_normalization: The reader sees which arithmetic costs each factor addresses and is warned that its growth enters the decay estimate.
sequential_reading_check.before_dilation_proposition: The reader has seen divisible factors recover a shorter product and other factors reduce to constants, including permutation of the fractional shifts.
sequential_reading_check.limit: This is a targeted authoring review, not an independent assessment or a human reader study.
